verdict.rationale: sevDesk documents its own REST API that 'lets you manage data and features in sevdesk', backed by a large published OpenAPI 3.0 spec. No evidence states or shows that the API matches the UI feature for feature, so parity is unproven. Several UI capabilities, such as the ELSTER VAT return, the dashboard, BWA reports, bank payments and dunning, have no API evidence. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, documented API coverage of UI features like ELSTER submission, banking/payments, reports and dunning, and independent hands-on confirmation of coverage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The REST API lets you manage data and features in sevdesk and connect external services to sevdesk.
sevdesk publishes its full OpenAPI 3.0.0 document (671 KB YAML, base https://my.sevdesk.de/api/v1)
